newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Coca-Cola Amatil unchanged. [CORRECTED 23:59 GMT]
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Coca-Cola Amatil unchanged. [CORRECTED 23:59 GMT]

text.p: (Corrects headline and text to show that the rating has not in fact been cut)
-- Deutsche Morgan Grenfell said it has maintained Australia's Coca-Cola Amatil Ltd at accumulate.

-- "We still believe that the company's long-term story is intact and would recommend that long-term investors buy the stock on weakness; however, earnings growth will likely be lackluster over the next two years," analyst Richard Beaurepaire wrote in a Feb 18 report.
